title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Watermelon Ice
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Watermelon Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This handy replacement pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a cool and fruity flavour blend. Watermelon Ice pairs the fresh, delicately sweet taste of ripe Watermelon with a brisk Menthol finish for a vape that’s light, breezy and satisfying. It's a great choice for vapers who enjoy clean-tasting fruit flavours with a refreshing twist. Each pod and refill pack is designed exclusively for the Dojo Blast 10K device and offers up to 10,000 puffs (device total), powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour.
